sealed_record.thesis: Korean press via jukan05 (2026-10-09) reports Samsung Electro-Mechanics is close to a KRW 700bn MLCC long-term agreement to supply Delta Electronics. That detail has been almost entirely ignored because everyone read the same article for the Samsung memory LTA headline (75-80% of next year's supply volume already contracted). An MLCC LTA of that size is a component buyer pre-committing to multi-year volume — it is a leading indicator of Delta's own AI power-electronics unit shipments, disclosed by its supplier rather than by Delta. You are getting the customer's forward volume signal from the supply side before it appears in guidance.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP -45.8%. Ditutup dalam AI trade unwind 17 Nov. Sempat terhapus dari ledger pagi itu dan dikembalikan karena call ini sudah ter-commit di track record.
